messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: release/2026-03-15-db-migration -> prod canary (10%)
alex: FYI includes migration `add_column_to_orders` (non-destructive) and small API change to read column
maria: canary traffic looks okay initially
incident-bot: Alert: 5xx rate spike on /orders (canary) - threshold breached
priya: I'm on pager, grabbing logs
pagerduty: Paging priya (oncall) for incident INC-2026-045
priya: I see `ERROR: column "new_status" does not exist` in logs, failing write path
josh: that's odd — migration was supposed to be backward compatible. which service is hitting it?
elena: orders-ingest (v2) - deployed in canary. Stack trace points to orm migration dependency
ken: canary traffic shows ~20% errors, latency up
alex: hmm migration script did `ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN new_status text;` and then app writes to it. maybe migration hasn't finished on all DB nodes
maria: DB migration job shows state `running`, but last step stuck on `creating index concurrently`
sam: running `select pid, query, state from pg_stat_activity where query like '%CREATE INDEX%'` shows pid 8342 blocked
priya: any long running tx holding lock? run:
```
select pid, usename, query_start, state, wait_event from pg_stat_activity where state <> 'idle';
```
alex: found tx from analytic_batch job started 2h ago holding relation lock
josh: that job shouldn't run during deploy — it was scheduled by cron. Who kicked it off?
maria: looks like nightly job retriggered after node failover, it started and got stuck during reindex
priya: mitigation plan: 1) pause canary rollout 2) flip feature flag to not write new column 3) kill blocking pid 4) resume migration
ken: flipping ff `orders.new_status_write` to off now :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by priya
alex: apps should fallback to old write path — verify
josh: confirmed ingest rate drops to normal and 5xxs stop for canary
priya: issuing `select pg_terminate_backend(8342);` after notifying analytics team
opsbot: Terminated pid 8342, connection closed
maria: migration job resumed, index creation running, no more blocking tx
sam: monitoring replication lag — small spike but within SLO
priya: starting controlled resume of canary with ff still off, we'll monitor errors
elena: rolling forward to 30% canary
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created, severity: P1, owner: priya
pagerduty: Handoff note: priya handing to alex in 15m for monitoring and postmortem
priya: taking notes: root cause = long-running analytics txn holding lock, migration non-robust to concurrent DDL. Action items: add migration pre-checks, prevent cron during deploys, improve migration docs, add automatic ff fallback
alex: will run follow-up: add pre-deploy hook to detect concurrent tx and block migrations
maria: customers impacted: short window (approx 12m) of ingest failures for a subset of canary tenants; no broad data loss; retry logic kept most clients safe
sam: adding timeline and commands used to incident ticket
josh: postmortem assignee: alex; target ETA for report EOD tomorrow
priya: closing incident channel when handoff complete
alex: taking over monitoring, thanks team :heart:
